facts.text: The UIC Aspire program pays 100% of UIC tuition and fees, including tuition differentials and mandatory fees.

sources.title: UIC Aspire - University of Illinois Chicago
sources.quote: The UIC Aspire program pays 100% of UIC tuition and fees (including tuition differentials) and mandatory fees.

facts.text: Through UIC Aspire, new first-year and transfer students in Illinois whose families earn $75,000 or less may be eligible for $0 tuition and fees.

sources.title: UIC Aspire - University of Illinois Chicago
sources.quote: Are you an Illinois student whose family earns $75,000 or less? New first-year and transfer students may be eligible for $0 tuition and fees at UIC.
